action_instruction: Reading the position size from the Result panel
intent: the position size amount in the Result panel

action_params.condition: the Result panel shows a position size of exactly 25.00 ETH
action_params.query: the position size amount in the Result panel

action_instruction: Reading the actual risk from the Result panel
intent: the actual risk amount in the Result panel

action_params.condition: the actual risk shown is exactly $7.50
action_params.query: the actual risk amount in the Result panel

action_instruction: Comparing the displayed actual risk with the risk budget
intent: the difference between the displayed risk budget and actual risk

action_params.condition: the actual risk shown is not greater than the risk budget the page shows under the "Risk per trade" field (balance 2500 multiplied by 0.3% is $7.50 rounded to the cent)
action_params.query: the difference between the displayed risk budget and actual risk

intent: the displayed position size in the Result panel

action_params.condition: the displayed position size is stored as {{displayed_size}}
action_params.query: the displayed position size in the Result panel

intent: the displayed actual risk in the Result panel

action_params.condition: the displayed actual risk is stored as {{displayed_risk}}
action_params.query: the displayed actual risk in the Result panel

assertion_tree.description: the Result panel shows a position size of exactly 25.00 ETH, the actual risk shown is exactly $7.50, and the actual risk shown is not greater than the risk budget the page shows under the "Risk per trade" field (balance 2500 multiplied by 0.3% is $7.50 rounded to the cent)

sub_results.description: the Result panel shows a position size of exactly 25.00 ETH
the actual risk shown is exactly $7.50
the actual risk shown is not greater than the risk budget the page shows under the "Risk per trade" field (balance 2500 multiplied by 0.3% is $7.50 rounded to the cent)

assertion_tree.verification: The current Result panel and the page's "Risk per trade" field show the specified position size, actual risk, and risk-budget relationship.
